title: Misery Traverse
lede: A one-way traverse from the western edge of Mudgee, up over Mount Misery and north along the ridge to Caerleon.
description: An 11.9 km one-way traverse from Rifle Range Road on the western edge of Mudgee, over Mount Misery and north along the ridge above Avisford Nature Reserve to the Castlereagh Highway at Caerleon.

facts.label: Highlights
facts.value: Mount Misery, the ridge above Avisford Nature Reserve

intro: Mount Misery is the high ground right on Mudgee's western doorstep. This traverse starts on the edge of town, climbs onto it along the Mount Misery Trail, then follows the long ridge north above Avisford Nature Reserve to finish at the Castlereagh Highway near Caerleon. [X: what makes it worth doing, in Matt's words]

getting_there.intro: This is a one-way walk, so you'll need a car at each end. The start and finish are about 4 km apart in a straight line.

options.heading: Rifle Range Road, Glen Ayr
options.text: The walk starts on Rifle Range Road at Glen Ayr, on the western edge of Mudgee, just west of Faucett Drive. [X: where to park]

options.heading: Castlereagh Highway, Caerleon
options.text: The walk finishes on the Castlereagh Highway near the Blain Road turn-off at Caerleon, north-west of town. Leave a car here before you start. [X: where to park]

getting_there.note: [X: access or land notes, e.g. private property and permission, gates]

walk_intro: The route heads south from the edge of town to pick up the Mount Misery Trail, climbs over Mount Misery, then follows the ridge north for most of the way to Caerleon. [X: track or off-track, and conditions underfoot]

stops.heading: Rifle Range Road
stops.text: Set off from Rifle Range Road at Glen Ayr and head south, away from town, towards the hills. [X]

stops.heading: Mount Misery Trail
stops.text: Join the Mount Misery Trail and follow it west past the communication tower, where the climb onto Mount Misery begins. [X]

stops.heading: Mount Misery
stops.text: [X: what the top is like and what you can see from it]

stops.heading: The ridge north
stops.text: From Mount Misery, the route follows the long ridge north, keeping west of Avisford Nature Reserve, for about 6 km. [X: views, scrub, rock]

stops.heading: Castlereagh Highway, Caerleon
stops.text: Drop off the north end of the ridge to finish on the Castlereagh Highway near Caerleon, where your second car is waiting. [X]

tips.heading: Navigation
tips.text: [X: is the ridge section off-track and unmarked?] Carry a map and compass or GPS, and know how to use them.

tips.heading: Private land
tips.text: [X: does the route cross private property? If so, get the landholder's permission before you go.]

tips.heading: Water
tips.text: Carry all the water you'll need. [X: any water on the way?]

tips.heading: Respect the Country
tips.text: This is Wiradjuri Country. Look, but don't touch. Leave no trace.

tips.heading: Tell someone
tips.text: Leave your plans with someone. [X: phone coverage along the ridge]
